case_title: Shashikant Sharma & Ors. v. State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.
trial_court_outcome: Charges framed against the accused for the offences punishable under IPC and SC/ST Act
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleged that the accused fired a gun at the victim, resulting in an injury. However, the medicolegal report indicated that the victim had a boil/abscess on his thigh and no evidence of a gunshot injury was found. The case involved allegations of caste-based abuses by the accused against a witness who was a member of the Scheduled Caste community. The incident was described as having undertones of political rivalry. The investigation was reportedly manipulated, with the involvement of a former Cabinet Minister, and the FIR was registered only after court intervention. The accused were released on bonds, and the charges under the SC/ST Act were quashed.
